name: AI Vector DB: OpenSearch
description: OpenSearch vector-database provider plugin for the AI module's AI Search submodule. Delegates the HTTP client and credentials to Search API OpenSearch connectors (Key module).
project_description: The OpenSearch VDB Provider supplies a Vector Database provider plugin for the AI module, letting the AI Search submodule store and query vector embeddings in an OpenSearch cluster via its k-NN (approximate nearest neighbour) support. It reuses Search API OpenSearch's connector plugins for the OpenSearch PHP client, endpoint and authentication (via the Key module), and its FilterBuilder for translating Search API conditions into OpenSearch query DSL. Requirements: AI module, AI Search submodule, Key, and Search API OpenSearch.
